celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿الر﴾ Allah knows best what He means by it ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ these verses ﴿آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ﴾ the Quran; the iḍāfa (genitive construct) is in the sense of "min" (of) ﴿وَقُرْآنٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ which makes the truth plain, distinct from falsehood; it is a conjoining (ʿaṭf) with the addition of a description.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿رُبَّمَا﴾ with doubling (tashdīd) and without it [رُبَمَا] ﴿يَوَدُّ﴾ wish ﴿الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ on the Day of Resurrection, when they see their own state and the state of the Muslims ﴿لَوْ كَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ﴾. And "rubba" here is for multiplicity (taktīr), for that wish will be frequent among them; and it is said: for paucity (taqlīl), for the terrors will bewilder them so that they do not come to their senses enough to wish that, except at a few moments.

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿ذَرْهُمْ﴾ leave the disbelievers, O Muhammad ﴿يَأْكُلُوا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا﴾ with their worldly life ﴿وَيُلْهِهِمْ﴾ and let it occupy them ﴿الْأَمَلُ﴾ [hope] of long life and other things, away from faith ﴿فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the outcome of their affair. This was before the command to fight.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾ its people are meant ﴿إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ﴾ a term ﴿مَعْلُومٌ﴾ fixed for its destruction.

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ﴾ they are not delayed beyond it.

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا﴾ i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca, to the Prophet ﷺ ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ﴾ the Quran, as he claims ﴿إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ﴾

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿لَوْمَا﴾ why not ﴿تَأْتِينَا بِالْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ in your saying that you are a prophet and that this Quran is from Allah. Allah the Exalted said:

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿مَا تَنَزَّلُ﴾ in it one of the two tāʾs has been dropped ﴿الْمَلَائِكَةُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ﴾ with the punishment ﴿وَمَا كَانُوا إِذًا﴾ i.e. when the angels descend with the punishment ﴿مُنْظَرِينَ﴾ granted respite [مَا نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ]

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿إِنَّا نَحْنُ﴾ an emphasis (tawkīd) of the noun of inna, or a separating pronoun (faṣl) ﴿نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ﴾ the Quran ﴿وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ﴾ from alteration, distortion, addition and diminution.

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ messengers ﴿فِي شِيَعِ﴾ the sects ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿وَمَا﴾ there used to ﴿يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ﴾ just as your people mock you; and this is a consolation for him.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿كَذَلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ﴾ i.e. just as We placed denial in the hearts of those, We place it ﴿فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ﴾ in the Prophet ﷺ ﴿وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ i.e. Allah's way with them, of punishing them for their denial of their prophets; and these are like them.

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَظَلُّوا فِيهِ﴾ in the gate ﴿يَعْرُجُونَ﴾ ascending

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿لَقَالُوا إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ﴾ have been blocked ﴿أَبْصَارُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَسْحُورُونَ﴾ that is made to appear to us.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا﴾ twelve: Aries (al-Ḥamal), Taurus (al-Thawr), Gemini (al-Jawzāʾ), Cancer (al-Saraṭān), Leo (al-Asad), Virgo (al-Sunbula), Libra (al-Mīzān), Scorpio (al-ʿAqrab), Sagittarius (al-Qaws), Capricorn (al-Jady), Aquarius (al-Dalw) and Pisces (al-Ḥūt). They are the mansions of the seven moving planets: Mars, to which belong Aries and Scorpio; Venus, to which belong Taurus and Libra; Mercury, to which belong Gemini and Virgo; the Moon, to which belongs Cancer; the Sun, to which belongs Leo; Jupiter, to which belong Sagittarius and Pisces; and Saturn, to which belong Capricorn and Aquarius. ﴿وَزَيَّنَّاهَا﴾ with the stars ﴿لِلنَّاظِرِينَ﴾

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿وَحَفِظْنَاهَا﴾ with shooting flames ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ﴾ stoned

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿إِلَّا﴾ but ﴿مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ﴾ snatched it ﴿فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ a star that shines and burns him, or pierces him, or deranges him.

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا﴾ We spread it out ﴿وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ﴾ firm mountains, so that it does not shake with its inhabitants ﴿وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْزُونٍ﴾ known and measured.

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ﴾ with yāʾ: of fruits and grains; and We made for you ﴿وَمَنْ لَسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرَازِقِينَ﴾ such as slaves, riding animals and cattle, for it is Allah alone who provides for them.

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ not ﴿مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿شَيْءٍ إِلَّا عِنْدَنَا خَزَائِنُهُ﴾ the keys of its treasuries ﴿وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ﴾ according to what is beneficial.

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ﴾ they fertilise the clouds so that they fill with water ﴿فَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ﴾ the clouds ﴿مَاءً﴾ rain ﴿فَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمُوهُ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ لَهُ بِخَازِنِينَ﴾ i.e. its storehouses are not in your hands.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ الْوَارِثُونَ﴾ the Everlasting; We inherit all creation.

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنْكُمْ﴾ i.e. those of creation who came before, from the time of Adam ﴿وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ﴾ those who come later, until the Day of Resurrection.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُ حَكِيمٌ﴾ in His making ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ of His creation.

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ﴾ Adam ﴿مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ﴾ dry clay which gives a ringing (ṣalṣala), i.e. a sound, when struck ﴿مِنْ حَمَإٍ﴾ black mud ﴿مَسْنُونٍ﴾ altered.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿وَالْجَانَّ﴾ the father of the jinn, who is Iblīs ﴿خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ i.e. before the creation of Adam ﴿مِنْ نَارِ السَّمُومِ﴾ it is a smokeless fire that penetrates the pores.

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿وَ﴾ remember ﴿إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ﴾

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ﴾ I have completed him ﴿وَنَفَخْتُ﴾ and made flow ﴿فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِي﴾ so that he became alive; and the attribution of the spirit to Him is an honouring of Adam ﴿فَقَعُوا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ﴾ a prostration of greeting, by bowing.

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ﴾ in it there are two emphases (tawkīd).

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ﴾ he is the father of the jinn; he was among the angels ﴿أَبَى﴾ he refused ﴿أَنْ يَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ﴾

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ the Exalted ﴿يَا إِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ﴾ what prevented you ﴿أَ﴾ n ﴿لَا﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿تَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: the source splits أَلَّا into ﴿أَ﴾ + نْ + ﴿لَا﴾, i.e. أَنْ followed by a redundant لَا.]

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿قَالَ لَمْ أَكُنْ لِأَسْجُدَ﴾ it is not fitting for me to prostrate ﴿لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ﴾

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا﴾ i.e. from the Garden; and it is said: from the heavens ﴿فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ﴾ banished

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ﴾ the Requital

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ﴾ i.e. mankind

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿إِلَى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ﴾ the time of the first blowing [of the Trumpet].

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي﴾ i.e. by Your leading me astray; the bāʾ is for the oath, and its answer is ﴿لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ acts of disobedience ﴿وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ﴾

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ i.e. the believers.

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ the Exalted ﴿هَذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ﴾ and it is [Translator's note: the sentence continues into the next verse].

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿إِنَّ عِبَادِي﴾ i.e. the believers ﴿لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ﴾ power ﴿إِلَّا﴾ but ﴿مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ﴾ the disbelievers.

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ i.e. those who follow you, together with you.

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ﴾ levels ﴿لِكُلِّ بَابٍ﴾ of them ﴿مِنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ﴾ a share ﴿مَقْسُومٌ﴾

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ﴾ gardens ﴿وَعُيُونٍ﴾ flowing in them; and it will be said to them:

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿ادْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ﴾ i.e. safe from everything feared; or: with a greeting of peace, i.e. greet [one another] and enter ﴿آمِنِينَ﴾ from every fright.

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِمْ مِنْ غِلٍّ﴾ rancour ﴿إِخْوَانًا﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial) of "هِمْ" ﴿عَلَى سُرُرٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ﴾ also a ḥāl, i.e. none of them looks at the back of another's head, because the couches revolve with them.

celaleyn:48-48.t: ﴿لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ﴾ fatigue ﴿وَمَا هُمْ مِنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ﴾ ever.

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿نَبِّئْ﴾ inform, O Muhammad ﴿عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ﴾ to the believers ﴿الرَّحِيمُ﴾ to them.

celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي﴾ for the disobedient ﴿هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْأَلِيمُ﴾ the painful.

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَنْ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ﴾ they were angels, twelve, or ten, or three, among them Jibrīl.

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا سَلَامًا﴾ i.e. this very word ﴿قَالَ﴾ Ibrāhīm, when he offered them food and they did not eat ﴿إِنَّا مِنْكُمْ وَجِلُونَ﴾ afraid.

celaleyn:53-53.t: ﴿قَالُوا لَا تَوْجَلْ﴾ do not fear ﴿إِنَّا﴾ the messengers of your Lord ﴿نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ﴾ possessed of much knowledge; he is Isḥāq, as we mentioned in Sūrat Hūd.

celaleyn:54-54.t: ﴿قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِي﴾ with a son ﴿عَلَى أَنْ مَسَّنِيَ الْكِبَرُ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. while it has touched me ﴿فَبِمَ﴾ with what thing then ﴿تُبَشِّرُونَ﴾ a question expressing wonder.

celaleyn:55-55.t: ﴿قَالُوا بَشَّرْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ with the truth ﴿فَلَا تَكُنْ مِنَ الْقَانِطِينَ﴾ the despairing.

celaleyn:56-56.t: ﴿قَالَ وَمَنْ﴾ i.e. no one ﴿يَقْنِطُ﴾ with kasra on the nūn, and with fatḥa [يَقْنَطُ] ﴿مِنْ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ﴾ the disbelievers.

celaleyn:58-58.t: ﴿قَالُوا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمٍ مُجْرِمِينَ﴾ disbelievers, i.e. the people of Lūṭ, to destroy them.

celaleyn:59-59.t: ﴿إِلَّا آلَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ because of their faith.

celaleyn:60-60.t: ﴿إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَا إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ﴾ those remaining in the punishment, because of her disbelief.

celaleyn:62-62.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ to them ﴿إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ﴾ I do not know you.

celaleyn:63-63.t: ﴿قَالُوا بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِمَا كَانُوا﴾ i.e. your people ﴿فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ﴾ doubt, and that is the punishment.

celaleyn:64-64.t: ﴿وَأَتَيْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ﴾ in what we say.

celaleyn:65-65.t: ﴿فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَاتَّبِعْ أَدْبَارَهُمْ﴾ walk behind them ﴿وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ﴾ lest he see the terrible thing that befalls them ﴿وَامْضُوا حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ﴾ and that is Syria (al-Shām).

celaleyn:66-66.t: ﴿وَقَضَيْنَا﴾ We revealed ﴿إِلَيْهِ ذَلِكَ الْأَمْرَ﴾ which is ﴿أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَؤُلَاءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُصْبِحِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. their extermination will be completed in the morning.

celaleyn:67-67.t: ﴿وَجَاءَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ﴾ the city of Sodom (Sadūm), and they were the people of Lūṭ, when they were told that in Lūṭ's house there were handsome beardless youths, and they were the angels ﴿يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ﴾ a ḥāl: hoping to commit the indecency with them.

celaleyn:69-69.t: ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ﴾ by your setting out to commit the indecency with them.

celaleyn:70-70.t: ﴿قَالُوا أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾ from hosting them.

celaleyn:71-71.t: ﴿قَالَ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ﴾ what you want of satisfying desire, then marry them.

celaleyn:72-72.t: ﴿لَعَمْرُكَ﴾ an address to the Prophet ﷺ, i.e. by your life ﴿إِنَّهُمْ لَفِي سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ﴾ wander in confusion.

celaleyn:73-73.t: ﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ the cry of Jibrīl ﴿مُشْرِقِينَ﴾ at the time of sunrise.

celaleyn:74-74.t: ﴿فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا﴾ i.e. their towns ﴿سَافِلَهَا﴾ in that Jibrīl raised them to the sky and dropped them upside down onto the earth ﴿وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ﴾ clay baked by fire.

celaleyn:75-75.t: ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned ﴿لَآيَاتٍ﴾ indications of the oneness of Allah ﴿لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ﴾ for those who observe and take lessons.

celaleyn:76-76.t: ﴿وَإِنَّهَا﴾ i.e. the towns of the people of Lūṭ ﴿لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُقِيمٍ﴾ the route of Quraysh to Syria; they have not been effaced. Will they then not take a lesson from them?

celaleyn:78-78.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ lightened (mukhaffafa) [from inna], i.e. "innahu" ﴿كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ﴾ it is a thicket of trees near Madyan, and they were the people of Shuʿayb ﴿لَظَالِمِينَ﴾ by their denial of Shuʿayb.

celaleyn:79-79.t: ﴿فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ﴾ by destroying them with intense heat ﴿وَإِنَّهُمَا﴾ i.e. the towns of the people of Lūṭ and of al-Ayka ﴿لَبِإِمَامٍ﴾ a road ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ clear. Will you then not take a lesson from them, O people of Mecca?

celaleyn:80-80.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ الْحِجْرِ﴾ a valley between Medina and Syria, and they were Thamūd ﴿الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ by their denial of Ṣāliḥ, because it is a denial of the rest of the messengers, since they share in bringing [the message of] divine oneness (tawḥīd).

celaleyn:81-81.t: ﴿وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ آيَاتِنَا﴾ in the she-camel ﴿فَكَانُوا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ﴾ they did not reflect on them.

celaleyn:82-82.t: ﴿وَكَانُوا يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا آمِنِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:83-83.t: ﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ﴾ at the time of morning.

celaleyn:84-84.t: ﴿فَمَا أَغْنَى﴾ warded off ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ the punishment ﴿مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ﴾ of building fortresses and amassing wealth.

celaleyn:85-85.t: ﴿وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَآتِيَةٌ﴾ inevitably, and everyone will be requited for his deeds ﴿فَاصْفَحِ﴾ O Muhammad, from your people ﴿الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيلَ﴾ turn away from them with a turning away in which there is no distress. This is abrogated by the Verse of the Sword.

celaleyn:86-86.t: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ﴾ of everything ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ of everything.

celaleyn:87-87.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ سَبْعًا مِنَ الْمَثَانِي﴾ he ﷺ said: "It is al-Fātiḥa", narrated by the two Shaykhs [al-Bukhārī and Muslim]; because it is repeated in every rakʿa ﴿وَالْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ﴾

celaleyn:88-88.t: ﴿لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا﴾ categories ﴿مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ if they do not believe ﴿وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ﴾ be gentle ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾

celaleyn:89-89.t: ﴿وَقُلْ إِنِّي أَنَا النَّذِيرُ﴾ of Allah's punishment, lest it descend upon you ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾ clear in warning.

celaleyn:90-90.t: ﴿كَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا﴾ the punishment ﴿عَلَى الْمُقْتَسِمِينَ﴾ the Jews and the Christians.

celaleyn:91-91.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا الْقُرْآنَ﴾ i.e. their scriptures revealed to them ﴿عِضِينَ﴾ parts, in that they believed in some and disbelieved in some. And it is said: what is meant by them are those who divided the roads of Mecca among themselves, turning people away from Islam; some of them said of the Quran that it was sorcery, some that it was soothsaying, and some that it was poetry.

celaleyn:92-92.t: ﴿فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْأَلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ a questioning of rebuke.

celaleyn:93-93.t: ﴿عَمَّا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:94-94.t: ﴿فَاصْدَعْ﴾ O Muhammad ﴿بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ﴾ [with it], i.e. proclaim it openly and carry it out ﴿وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ this was before the command to wage jihad.

celaleyn:95-95.t: ﴿إِنَّا كَفَيْنَاكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِئِينَ﴾ at you, by Our destroying each of them with an affliction; they were al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra, al-ʿĀṣī ibn Wāʾil, ʿAdī ibn Qays, al-Aswad ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib and al-Aswad ibn ʿAbd Yaghūth.

celaleyn:96-96.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); and it is said: a mubtadaʾ (subject), and because it contains the meaning of a condition the fāʾ entered its khabar (predicate), which is ﴿فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the outcome of their affair.

celaleyn:97-97.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ for affirmation (taḥqīq) ﴿نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ﴾ of mockery and denial.

celaleyn:98-98.t: ﴿فَسَبِّحْ﴾ joined ﴿بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ﴾ i.e. say "subḥāna Llāhi wa-bi-ḥamdih" ﴿وَكُنْ مِنَ السَّاجِدِينَ﴾ those who pray.
